label: Third Way necessity supports the existential respect reading
note: The Third Way asserts that some being cannot not-be after contrasting necessary being with things able to be and not be. This supports an existential reading of the necessity at issue. The later dichotomy about a cause of necessity supplies context. The route still needs to show that every NECESSARY_1 bearer satisfies NecessityConsistsIn at esse. Transferring from causing esse to causing its necessity is a separate premise.
